blueprints.name: Dependency Failure Isolation
blueprints.goal: Prevent one failed optional service from stopping the whole system.

blueprints.name: Resilience Proof Report
blueprints.goal: Summarize which failures have actually been tested and recovered from.

blueprints.name: Expected Versus Actual Impact
blueprints.goal: Compare blueprint impact predictions with observed results.

blueprints.name: Score Calibration Engine
blueprints.goal: Correct ranking formulas that consistently overestimate certain work.

blueprints.name: False Progress Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect activity such as commits or bot counts without measurable capability gain.

blueprints.name: Automation Debt Register
blueprints.goal: Track automation that itself creates maintenance burden.

blueprints.name: Complexity To Value Ratio
blueprints.goal: Measure value gained for each unit of complexity introduced.

blueprints.name: System Simplification Planner
blueprints.goal: Find components that can be merged or removed.

blueprints.name: Unknown Capability Discovery
blueprints.goal: Search recurring failures for missing classes of tools or knowledge.

blueprints.name: Benchmark Evolution Engine
blueprints.goal: Expand benchmarks only when a new failure class is observed.

blueprints.name: Constitution Compliance Auditor
blueprints.goal: Verify automation behavior matches the Mikis13 safety constitution.

blueprints.name: V10 Architecture Review
blueprints.goal: Run a periodic review of capability, reliability, complexity, evidence and owner control.

blueprints.name: Recovery Verification Contract
blueprints.goal: Define the exact observable condition proving that the original failure has disappeared.

blueprints.name: Before/After Evidence Snapshot
blueprints.goal: Capture evidence before a repair and compare it with evidence after the repair.

blueprints.name: Original Failure Replay
blueprints.goal: Re-run the original failing command, workflow check or health probe after repair.

blueprints.name: False Recovery Detector
blueprints.goal: Reject repairs that only hide a symptom while the original failure remains reproducible.

blueprints.name: Recovery Proof Bundle
blueprints.goal: Store failure evidence, repair commit, tests, healthcheck and verification result together.

blueprints.name: Canonical Job State Machine
blueprints.goal: Represent jobs as NEW, EVIDENCE_READY, READY, ACTIVE, BLOCKED, VERIFIED, FAILED or CLOSED.

blueprints.name: Atomic Job Claim
blueprints.goal: Allow only one worker group to claim a mutation job using atomic leases.

blueprints.name: Job Lease Expiration
blueprints.goal: Automatically release abandoned jobs after a bounded lease expires.

blueprints.name: Job Deduplication Fingerprint
blueprints.goal: Prevent creation of multiple active jobs describing the same repository problem.

blueprints.name: Job Priority Recalibration
blueprints.goal: Recalculate priority when evidence, failures, urgency or dependency state changes.

blueprints.name: Bounded Execution Planner
blueprints.goal: Translate one selected job into explicit deterministic execution stages.

blueprints.name: Mutation Authorization Gate
blueprints.goal: Permit repository mutation only after required gates are present and valid.

blueprints.name: Command Allowlist Runner
blueprints.goal: Allow only deterministic predefined commands instead of arbitrary AI-generated shell.

blueprints.name: Execution Checkpoint Manager
blueprints.goal: Create known-good state before any allowed mutation begins.

blueprints.name: Execution Result Normalizer
blueprints.goal: Convert command, test, security and healthcheck results into one structured result format.

blueprints.name: Failure Signature Canonicalizer V2
blueprints.goal: Normalize recurring failures into stable signatures independent of noisy timestamps.

blueprints.name: Regression Requirement Register
blueprints.goal: Require every confirmed recurring failure to gain a regression prevention requirement.

blueprints.name: Regression Test Linker
blueprints.goal: Link a confirmed failure signature to the test that prevents recurrence.

blueprints.name: Recurring Failure Escalator
blueprints.goal: Stop identical repair attempts after the failure limit and escalate to deeper diagnosis.

blueprints.name: Successful Fix Retrieval V2
blueprints.goal: Search verified historical fixes before inventing a new repair approach.

blueprints.name: Worker Outcome Ledger
blueprints.goal: Record whether each worker recommendation resulted in verified improvement.

blueprints.name: Worker Accuracy Score
blueprints.goal: Calculate worker quality from verified results instead of message volume.

blueprints.name: Worker Domain Competence
blueprints.goal: Track which worker families perform best for testing, reliability, GitHub, security and architecture.

blueprints.name: Worker Cooldown Engine
blueprints.goal: Reduce selection probability after repeated failed recommendations.

blueprints.name: Worker Promotion Gate
blueprints.goal: Increase worker responsibility only after repeated verified successful outcomes.

blueprints.name: Blueprint Maturity State Machine
blueprints.goal: Enforce IDEA through PROVEN lifecycle transitions with explicit gate requirements.

blueprints.name: Prototype Promotion Gate
blueprints.goal: Require reproducible prototype evidence before moving PLANNED to PROTOTYPE.

blueprints.name: Verified Capability Gate
blueprints.goal: Require deterministic tests and health evidence before marking capability VERIFIED.

blueprints.name: Deployed Capability Verification
blueprints.goal: Confirm behavior in the deployed environment before DEPLOYED is accepted.

blueprints.name: Proven Capability Evidence
blueprints.goal: Require repeated real-world successful use before promoting DEPLOYED to PROVEN.

blueprints.name: Repository Dependency Graph V2
blueprints.goal: Model repositories, workflows, domains, APIs and deployment relationships.

blueprints.name: Change Impact Propagation
blueprints.goal: Predict which dependent repositories or services may be affected by a proposed change.

blueprints.name: Dependency Critical Path
blueprints.goal: Identify the order in which blocked dependencies must be repaired.

blueprints.name: Single Point Of Failure Finder
blueprints.goal: Detect critical components that lack fallback, redundancy or recovery.

blueprints.name: Dependency Drift Monitor
blueprints.goal: Detect when observed repository relationships differ from the stored system map.

blueprints.name: Historical Prompt Benchmark Corpus
blueprints.goal: Store sanitized historical engineering cases used to evaluate prompt changes.

blueprints.name: Prompt Behavioral Contract
blueprints.goal: Define required safety, evidence and usefulness behaviors for every benchmark case.

blueprints.name: Prompt Candidate Comparator
blueprints.goal: Compare current and proposed prompts on the same benchmark cases.

blueprints.name: Prompt Regression Rejector
blueprints.goal: Reject prompt changes that reduce safety, evidence quality or successful task completion.

blueprints.name: Prompt Improvement Evidence
blueprints.goal: Require measurable benchmark improvement before accepting a prompt revision.

blueprints.name: Existing Solution Scout
blueprints.goal: Search existing Mikis13 repositories before proposing new implementation.

blueprints.name: Upstream Open Source Scout
blueprints.goal: Find relevant upstream or open-source implementations suitable for legal reuse.

blueprints.name: License Provenance Gate
blueprints.goal: Block code reuse when license or provenance cannot be established.

blueprints.name: Solution Comparison Matrix
blueprints.goal: Compare reuse, rewrite and new implementation by risk, complexity and maintenance.

blueprints.name: Research To Job Converter
blueprints.goal: Turn the highest-confidence research result into one bounded canonical job.

blueprints.name: Control Tower Status Model
blueprints.goal: Expose jobs, evidence, gates, workers, failures and system mode in one structured status object.

blueprints.name: Control Tower Health Summary
blueprints.goal: Display repository and automation health without hiding UNKNOWN states.

blueprints.name: Control Tower Active Job View
blueprints.goal: Show the one active mutation job and why it was selected.

blueprints.name: Control Tower Recovery View
blueprints.goal: Display checkpoints, failed attempts, rollback and recovery verification.

blueprints.name: Control Tower Owner Controls
blueprints.goal: Expose clear owner-controlled start, stop and safe-mode state without autonomous resistance.
